extracted.name: Zesty spritz
extracted.description: Make a refreshing, zesty spritz with our simple summer cocktail recipe, using sharp blood orange, bitters and prosecco for a dash of fun fizz
instruction_lines: Add all the ingredients to a high ball glass or a large wine glass and mix briefly. Top up with ice and garnish with an orange or grapefruit slice.
